definitions.explanation: wind blowing from the sea, often carrying the scent of salt

examples.japanese: {潮風|しおかぜ}が{気持|きも}ちいい。
{潮風|しおかぜ}に{当|あ}たりながら{散歩|さんぽ}する。
examples.english: To take a walk while enjoying the sea breeze.

examples.japanese: {潮風|しおかぜ}で{車|くるま}が{錆|さ}びやすい。
examples.english: Cars rust easily due to the salty sea air.

notes:
{潮風|しおかぜ} evokes the atmosphere of coastal areas.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {潮|しお} (tide, sea water, salt water)
- {風|かぜ} (wind, breeze)

CHARACTERISTICS:
- Carries the scent of salt ({塩|しお}の{香|かお}り)
- Often described as refreshing ({爽|さわ}やか)
- Can cause rust and corrosion due to salt content

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {潮風|しおかぜ}に{当|あ}たる (to be exposed to the sea breeze)
- {潮風|しおかぜ}を{感|かん}じる (to feel the sea breeze)
- {潮風|しおかぜ}の{香|かお}り (the scent of the sea breeze)

POETIC USAGE:
Often used in literature and poetry to evoke seaside settings and nostalgia.

RELATED TERMS:
- {海風|うみかぜ}/{海風|かいふう} (sea wind)
- {浜風|はまかぜ} (beach wind)
- {磯|いそ}の{香|かお}り (scent of the shore)
